title: Keyword Arguments a SparkParquetReader
description: Arguments to contol how the PySpark Parquet Reader interacts with a parquet files

datetime_rebase_mode.description: The datetimeRebaseMode option allows to specify the rebasing mode for the values of the DATE, TIMESTAMP_MILLIS, TIMESTAMP_MICROS logical types from the Julian to Proleptic Gregorian calendar. Default is `"EXCEPTION"`

int96_rebase_mode.description: The int96RebaseMode option allows to specify the rebasing mode for INT96 timestamps from the Julian to Proleptic Gregorian calendar. Default is `"EXCEPTION"`.
